The '''Kogini''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="RJ" /> [[Anbert Dregil]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Biology and appearance==
The Kogini were a quadrupedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin, hunched posture, massive [[Limb|arms]] and hands, and flat faces.<ref name="RJ" /> They possessed wide [[mouth]]s, exposed [[Nose|nostrils]], and small [[eye]]s that could perceive the [[ultraviolet]] spectrum.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Knuckle-Walking-Species.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Kogini in 132 BBY]]
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species<ref name="RJ" /> named [[Anbert Dregil]]<ref name="TAVG" /> had taken up residence on the [[planet]] [[Olega]],<ref name="RJ" /> working as a scrap merchant, hauler-for-hire, and stevedore, as well as collecting [[camera]] parts. They were well known around the city by nicknames such as "Long Arms" and "Ol' [[Gundark]]."<ref name="TAVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kogini made their debut in the [[Revenge / Justice|second episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="RJ" /> Their name was revealed within the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''<ref name="TAVG" /> which released in select countries on [[June 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241710425-star-wars-the-acolyte-visual-guide|text=Star Wars The Acolyte Visual Guide}}</ref>
